subject.title: fix(reply): prevent hung pre-delivery hooks from blocking lanes

question: Should existing unannotated `openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-runtime` pre-delivery callbacks receive a 15-second per-stage deadline by default?
rationale: The deadline prevents a severe serialized-lane deadlock, but it intentionally changes the timing and failure semantics of a shipped public plugin callback contract, which requires lifecycle-owner approval.

options.title: Adopt bounded default
options.body: Apply a 15-second deadline to each stage and require legitimately slower callback owners to declare a larger positive finite budget.

options.title: Preserve unbounded default
options.body: Keep existing callbacks unbounded unless they opt in, accepting that an unannotated callback can still indefinitely block its serialized delivery lane.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded default
recommendation.body: Apply a 15-second deadline to each stage and require legitimately slower callback owners to declare a larger positive finite budget.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history ties the original unified reply dispatcher and its lifecycle policy most directly to this owner candidate.
